title: B5: document the multi-executor pool: README access model, pool.toml comments, AGENTS.md note, CLAUDE.md status line
spec:
Why: B1–B4 change how work is routed; the docs must say how to add a model, how quota groups behave, how routing scores are computed, and that the benchmark snapshot is manual by design. Depends on B1–B4 merged into goal/T-0005.

What (≤4 files: README.md, .orchestrator/pool.toml (comments only), AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md):
1. README.md — new section "## Executors and routing" (≤25 lines): the [[executors]] table and its fields; how to enable a new model (add a row or flip enabled when the id shows in ~/.codex/models_cache.json; 6.x placeholders exist); quota_group semantics and the unconfirmed limit scope; pick_executor ranking = weight × score, score from `orchestrator scorecard` (success rate, usage-limit penalty), cold-start prior from `orchestrator bench` (hand-entered; no scraper, cite the Terms of Use reason); the CLI commands scorecard, bench show, bench set, status --plain. Update the "Access model" and "Verify on your machine" lists where they mention a single Astra model.
2. .orchestrator/pool.toml — comments only: one line above [[executors]] explaining the fields; one above the disabled 6.x rows.
3. AGENTS.md — one sentence: the executor model is chosen per task by the orchestrator; do not switch models mid-task.
4. CLAUDE.md — in "Always" item 10, add: "`status()` lists executors; `orchestrator scorecard` shows which model earns work; enable new ids in pool.toml, never hard-code a model in a spec."
No code changes. Run `uv run python -m unittest tests/test_orchestrator.py` to prove nothing broke. Commit: "docs: executors, routing scores, quota groups, manual benchmark snapshot" with a revert-path body.
acceptance: README.md contains a section '## Executors and routing' mentioning quota_group, scorecard, bench and the Terms of Use reason
pool.toml has explanatory comments above [[executors]] and above the disabled 6.x rows; toml still parses (uv run python -c 'import tomllib;tomllib.load(open(".orchestrator/pool.toml","rb"))')
uv run python -m unittest tests/test_orchestrator.py exits 0
git diff --stat limited to README.md, .orchestrator/pool.toml, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md

**Files changed:** README.md, .orchestrator/pool.toml, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md (diff scope matches exactly).

**Tests:** `uv run python -m unittest tests/test_orchestrator.py` → 63 tests, OK. `tests_green.sh` → exit 0, no failures. No code changes.
